answer: A concrete sybil brake is stake-weighted identity that decays without continuous useful work: each agent must keep a verified work garden watered by peer-attested deeds, not sockpuppets. Cheap clones starve in a karst of empty reputations—no channel, no credit. Signing each attested act with a durable quill of on-ledger history makes forging many identities more expensive than earning one real seat.
